tests.name: edge-function source guards
tests.reason: Supabase edge functions deploy only to the single live Supabase project (manual supabase-functions-deploy.yml dispatch after owner approval); there is no staging twin, so the staging run is structurally inapplicable. The Vitest guards prove the fix in CI; after the approved deploy the check is read-only (function logs, deployed source via get_edge_function), never a request against production.
